Commentary.Commentary: So, will Oman chase this target down or will Canada keep them under check? Join us in a while to find out.

Khawar Ali is down for an interview. He states that his main was aim was to try to bowl wicket-to-wicket and bowl some variations. Adds that the whole team is working very hard along with the coaching staff. Says he is hoping that they will chase down this target. States that the Powerplay is very important for them in this chase.
Skipper Zeeshan Maqsood was probably the pick of the bowlers for Oman as he picked up a 3-fer. He was also very well supported by Khawar Ali who picked up 2 wickets and being very cheap.

Canada started really well with Shrimantha Wijeyeratne coming out firing on all cylinders. He hit  56 runs off 36 balls and gave the Canadian innings the momentum it needed to push onto a big score. Nitish Kumar and Ravinderpal Singh got into the 20s but could not push on. Except for them, no one scored many runs as Oman tightened the screws late in the game. The flow of runs stopped which put pressure on the Canada batters. They collapsed in the end as Canada added just 38 runs in the last 33 balls of the innings while losing 6 wickets.
What a comeback this has been by the Oman team. At one point it looked like Canada would easily cross the 160-run mark but they have been restricted to just 144 runs.

RUN OUT! Third of the over. Fantastic over to end the innings for Oman. Khan bowls a yorker and Dutta just about squeezes it out to mid off. He soon runs to the other end. He wants a second too and calls his partner. But Mohammad Nadeem from long off throws the ball towards the bowler's end. The batsmen are stranded in the middle as Bilal Khan dislodges the bails at the non-striker's end. CANADA FINISH WITH 144/9 on the board.
Driven towards the mid-off region. The batsmen pick up a single.
Romesh Eranga walks in with 2 balls remaining in the innings.

RUN OUT! Second run out of the over. Khan bowls a length ball outside off, Dutta looks to run that down but fails to lay bat on ball. Dutta hares to the other end in search of a bye. Suraj Kumar behind the stumps collects the ball and scores a bull's eye to find the batsman short. Oman have done extremely well to make a  good come back here.
Nikhil Dutta comes in now.

RUN OUT! A wicket in pursuit of runs. Heyliger lofts this fuller ball outside off over mid off. The batsmen cross for a single and they look for the second as Mohammad Nadeem from long off is late to get to the ball. The fielder from long off throws it straight to the keeper Suraj Kumar who dislodges the bails to find Dillon Heyliger short of his crease.
Fuller length and on pads, Heyliger lofts it over mid on for a couple.
Full toss wide outside off, smashed over covers for a single.
The batsman has picked it early and slogged it through the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dillon Heyliger is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Goud again takes the catch. This dismissal is similar to the last one. Floated on middle, Ravinderpal Singh looks to slog sweep it but hits it straight to Sandeep Goud who again takes an easy catch. Canada losing their way here after a good start.
Tossed up on off, Singh lofts it over covers for a couple.
Hamza Tariq is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sandeep Goud takes the catch in the deep and the 5th wicket is down for Canada! Floated on middle and off, Abraash gets down on one knee and looks to slog sweep it over the deep mid-wicket fielder for a maximum. He does not time it well and Goud in the deep takes an easy catch. Canada stumbling a bit here.
Flatter one on off, Singh plays the pull to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Khan comes down the track tob hoick it to the leg side. But gets it off the inside edge to mid-wicket for a single.
Zeeshan Maqsood to bowl now.
FOUR! Some relief for the Canada batters! Singh gets onto the back foot and pulls this length ball powerfully towards mid-wicket. The ball goes on the bounce and into the fence.
This time Abraash times his cut shot well but it goes straight to the point fielder in the deep. The batters take one.
Another length ball outside off, Abraash again looks to cut but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. The batters take two.
Length ball outside off, Abraash looks to cut but misses the ball.
On the pads of Abraash, he flicks this one with soft hands towards mid-wicket. The batters spot an opportunity for a second run and are quick to complete it. Good running.
Short of a length on off, Singh pulls this one towards square leg for a single.
Bilal Khan comes back to bowl. His figures read 1-0-16-0.
Singh drives this one towards the cover region and takes a single to retain strike.
Abraash pushes this one off the back foot towards long off for one.
Yorker by Kaleem, Abraash does well to dig it out.
Singh flicks this one towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

Brilliant fielding! Full, floated and way outside off. Abraash Khan does well to reach to that one and slaps it towards cover. Khawar Ali there dives to his right and saves at least a couple of runs for the team. The batters take a single.
Darts one fuller and just outside off, the batter flicks it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, Singh plays it to long on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Singh plays it to long on and hares for a couple.
Tossed up outside off, Khan punches it off the back foot to the covers for a single.
Tossed up on pads, Singh works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off once again flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, Khan flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Down the leg side, Abraash Khan goes down on one knee and plays the paddle sweep towards fine leg. The fielder in the deep mops it up and the batters take three. He is off the mark with this.
On the pads, Singh flicks this one towards square leg for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards point.
Abraash Khan is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A very good catch in the deep by Khurram Nawaz! Floated on middle and off, Nitish Kumar dances down the track and tries to heave it towards mid-wicket for a maximum. He does not get the perfect connection on this one and the ball lobs wide of long on. Khurram Nawaz runs across to his right and takes a good catch in the deep while keeping his balance to stay inside the field and not touch the boundary rope. Canada 4 down and Oman hunting for the 5th wicket.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for one.

Dropped! Full ball on middle and off, Singh dances down the track and smashes it back towards the bowler. Kaleem tries to get both his hands to it but the ball goes through them through towards long off.
Aamir Kaleem is back into the attack. 2-0-12-0 his figures so far.
Fullish delivery outside off, Kumar pushes it to point for nothing
Full delivery on middle, Ravinderpal flicks it towards the square leg region and crosses over for a single.
WIDE! Slower full delivery down the leg side, Singh lets it go. It is wided.
BOUNCER! Nadeem aims it the body of Kumar who does well to duck under it.
Short ball outside off, Nitish punches this off the back foot and takes a single.
Full delivery on middle, Kumar pushes it to long on and takes off for a quick couple. Excellent running.

FOUR! What a shot from Kumar! Short ball on middle, Nitish moves towards the leg side and pulls it with disdain towards the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary. Wonder why the Omani players are standing so far inside the boundary line.
Flighted delivery on middle, Singh looks to flick it but it goes uppishly towards the bowler who collects it on the bounce.
The batsman gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads.
Flighted delivery on off, Kumar defends it off the front foot towards the point region and takes a single.
Flatter delivery outside off, Kumar pushes it to cover off the back foot.
Floated ball on off, Singh looks to defend it but it goes off the inside edge towards the mid-wicket region and gets off the mark with a single.
Ravinderpal Singh is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Innovation has brought about the downfall of Kirton! Khawar bowls a flighted delivery on off, Nicholas attempts a reverse sweep but fails to get any bat on it. It hits him on the pads. The Omani players put in a huge appeal and the umpire gives it out immediately. Ali gets his second wicket.
On a length outside off, Kirton  pushes it towards the cover region and takes off for a quick single. The fielder from cover has a shy at the stumps but misses.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Short delivery outside off, Kumar cuts it towards the deep cover region for another couple.
Good length delivery on middle, Kirton looks to pull it but it hits him on the thigh pad off the inside edge and rolls towards fine leg for a single.
LEG BYE! Good length delivery on the pads, Kumar looks to flick it but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire shakes his head. It was probably a bit high. The batters take a leg bye.
Full delivery on off, Kumar drives it towards long on and takes off for a couple. The fielder from long on runs in and cleans it up. Excellent running though.
Mohammad Nadeem is into the attack.
Kirton flicks this tossed up ball on his pads to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Kumar drives it through covers. It is a long extra cover boundary so the ball stops inside the ropes to be fielded by the fielder. In the meanwhile the batsmen take three.
Tossed up on pads, Kirton flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! This time Kirton finds the placement right. Ali tosses one up outside off and Kirton reverse sweeps it fine past the backward point fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up outside off, Kirton plays the reverse sweep but cannot find the placement right. The ball goes to backward point.
BEATEN! Tossed up ball outside off, Kirton looks to work it to the leg side but the ball goes past the edge.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Full delivery on middle, Kirton defends it off the front foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Nicholas Kirton Comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! What a piece of catching from Aamir Kaleem! Full delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne drives this towards cover but does so uppishly. Aamir Kaleem dives to his left and takes an excellent catch. Brilliant innings comes to an end.

FOUR! Nicely played! Flighted delivery on middle, Wijeyeratne comes down the track and flicks it uppishly towards between the  deep mid-wicket and long on fence. The fielder was standing way inside the boundary line. He should have been standing back to catch it.
Short delivery outside off, Srimantha cuts it towards cover-point where the fielder misfields. The ball rolls past him allowing the batsmen to take two.

FIFTY! A vital match and Srimantha has come back to form. Flatter delivery on middle, Srimantha flicks it towards the mid-wicket region and takes a single. It has been a good innings so far and he needs to continue for his team.
WIDE! Flighted delivery down the leg side, Wijeyeratne looks to flick it but fails to put any bat on it.
Full delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne drives it to the cover region for nothing.
Fullish delivery outside off, Kumar drives it to long off and takes another single.
Punched off the backfoot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full delivery on the pads, Srimantha sweeps it nicely but straight to the fine leg fielder. No run.
Full delivery outside off, Kumar pushes it towards long off and crosses over for a single.
Driven through mid-off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Flighted ball on off, Srimantha looks to sweep it but it goes off the top edge towards fine leg. The batters take a single.
Full delivery outside off, Srimantha drives it uppishly but it goes on the bounce to the cover fielder.
Flatter delivery on middle, Nitish flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Flighted delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne looks to defend it but it goes off the inside edge and towards fine leg. The batters cross for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Kumar punches it towards the cover region and takes a single.
Zeeshan Maqsood the skipper to bowl now.
Short ball outside off, Kumar cuts it towards the off side and takes a single. He gets off the mark with a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Nitish Kumar is the new man in!

OUT! BOWLED! Khawar Ali strikes! Flighted ball on middle, Navneet looks to slog it away but he fails to put any bat on it. The ball goes onto hit the top of off stump. Oman desperately needed the wicket and they have got one.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full delivery on off, Dhaliwal goes on his knees and sweeps it beautifully but straight to deep mid-wicket. The batters take a single.
Starts with a flighted delivery on middle, Navneet pushes it back to the bowler.
Khawar Ali comes on now.
Flatter delivery outside off, Dhaliwal pushes it towards the off side for a single. 56 runs have come off the Powerplay.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot..
Loopy ball outside off, Wijeyeratne looks to flick it but gets an inside edge which goes just past the leg stump towards fine leg. The batters take three before the fielder can clean it up.
WIDE! Bowls a ball way down the leg side, Srimantha looks to flick it but fails to put any bat on it. It is wided.
FOUR! Sciintillating shot from Srimantha! Short ball outside off, Wijeyeratne rocks on his back foot and cuts it towards the cover-point region for another boundary. 50 up for Canada.
Full delivery on the pads, Wijeyeratne looks to flick but gets beaten and the ball goes on to hit the pads.
BEATEN! Flatter delivery outside off, Srimantha looks to cut it but gets beaten completely. Good bowling from Kaleem.
Good length delivery on middle, Dhaliwal drives it towards the bowler. 17 runs have come from it.
Driven towards the mid-off region.
Short ball outside off, Srimantha cuts it towards the backward point region for three. The fielder runs in from the third man region and cleans it up before it reaches the ropes.
FOUR! Full delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne looks to drive but it goes off the edge towards the backward point region for another boundary. This is turning out to be an excellent over for Canada.
WIDE! Tries a bouncer on the short ball does Butt! Srimantha looks to pull it but misses. The ball is so high that it is wided.
FREE HIT CONTINUES!
It's a FREE HIT!

NO BALL AND FOUR! Poor bowling this from Butt! Another short one on middle, Srimantha pulls it with disdain towards the deep mid-wicket region for another boundary. The fielder comes across and tries to make a stop but it deflects off his hand. The ball then rolls into the fence. A free hit will follow.
FOUR! Brilliantly played! Another short delivery on middle, Srimantha hangs on his back foot and pulls it hard towards the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Wijeyeratne is on a rampage here.
Short ball on off, Wijeyeratne looks to pull but does not time it well. It goes on the bounce to the mid on fielder.
Full delivery on middle, Dhaliwal pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Floated ball on off, Srimantha looks to defend but it goes off the inside edge onto his pads and rolls towards the leg side for a single. The players appeal but nothing from the umpire.
Flighted ball on off, Dhaliwal looks to work it towards the leg side but it goes off the inside half of his bat towards mid-wicket. The batters take a single.
Flighted ball on middle, Srimantha comes down the track  and flicks it towards the mid-wicket region for a single.
Starts with a full delivery on middle, Srimantha defends it off the front foot back to the bowler.
First change for Oman. Aamir Kaleem comes on to bowl. Fayyaz Butt has called for the physio as he hurt his hand in trying to stop the previous ball.
Full delivery on middle, Dhaliwal drives this beautifully down the ground but the bowler makes the stop and the ball rolls towards the cover region.

Slower delivery on the middle and leg stump, Wijeyeratne flicks it towards the short fine leg region and takes off for a single. The fielder has a shy at the keeper's end and hits but the Dhaliwal was well in.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Good length delivery on middle, Navneet flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes off for a single.

Full delivery on middle, Navneet drives this well towards the bowler. Butt gets a hand on the ball as it rolls towards the stumps. The Oman players put in a stifled appeal but nothing from the umpire.
On a length on middle, Dhaliwal flicks it towards the deep square leg region and takes a couple. The fielder comes around and cleans it up.

FOUR! Just brilliant! Change in angle does not change the result for Bilal. Another full delivery outside off, Srimantha creams the cover drive towards the deep cover region for another boundary. Excellent over for Canada as 16 runs have come off it.
FOUR! Even better from Srimantha. Bilal bowls a full delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne drives it beautifully past the cover fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Bilal bowls a short delivery on the middle stump line. Wijeyeratyne rocks on his back foot and pulls it with disdain towards the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Another good length ball outside off, Wijeyeratne once again looks to guide it to third man but is beaten yet again. Good comeback by Bilal after being hit for a boundary off the first ball.
BEATEN! Back of a length delivery outside off, Wijeyeratne looks to guide this to third man but fails to put any bat on it.
FOUR! Poor start from Bilal! Short and wide outside off, Srimantha rocks on his back foot and cuts it nicely towards the cover-point region for the first boundary of the game.
Bilal Khan to bowl from the other end.
Short delivery outside off, Srimantha guides it to third man for a single. 7 runs have come off it.
Back of a length delivery on off, Wijeyeratne looks to guide it to third man but it hits the top of the handle and rolls onto the pitch.
Now Dhaliwal drives a full delivery towards the mid on region for a three. Maqsood runs after it again and makes another sliding stop before it reaches the ropes. Navneet is off the mark.

Fullish delivery outside off, Srimantha drives this beautifully through mid off and takes three.  Zeeshan Maqsood runs in from mid on and makes a sliding stop before it reaches the ropes. Canada are underway.
Fullish delivery on middle, Srimantha pushes it back to the bowler who jumps and collects the ball with one hand.
Starts with a good length ball outside off, Srimantha defends it off the front foot towards the cover region.
We are all set to begin! Navneet Dhaliwal and Srimantha Wijeyeratne make their way out to the middle. The Oman players are also making their way out. Fayyaz Butt to open the bowling.

Pitch report - Niall O'Brien is there for the pitch report, he says that looking at the previous scores, the ball might skid of the surface. Adds that the average score on this pitch is 134. Bazid Khan joins him and he says that on this pitch, the batsmen will have to allow the ball to come onto the bat.

Zeeshan Maqsood, the Oman captain, he says that they would have bowled first. Adds That boys are doing the hard work and are playing good cricket. Hopes that they qualify for the World Cup. Adds that they played last time in 2016 in India. Would love to play in Australia too.

Navneet Dhaliwal, the Canada captain, says they would like to bat first and look to defend that. Says that the pitch is looking good. Adds that this is a big ground and they will have to do a lot of running.  On the competition heating up, Dhaliwal adds that they are playing a vital game today and would look to do well.

Canada (PLAYING XI): Srimantha Wijeratne, Navneet Dhaliwal(C), Nitish Kumar, Nicholas Kirton, Abraash Khan, Ravinderpal Singh, Hamza Tariq(WK), Dillon Heyliger, Nikhil Dutta, Romesh Eranga, Jeremy Gordon.
Oman (PLAYING XI) - Jatinder Singh, Khawar Ali, Aqib Ilyas, Aamir Kaleem, Zeeshan Maqsood(C), Suraj Kumar(WK), Khurram Nawaz, Sandeep Goud, Mohammad Nadeem, Fayyaz Butt, Bilal Khan.
Toss - Canada have won the toss and they choose to bat first.

It's time for the clash of the top teams of Group B, Canada and Oman. The Canadians, coming from a loss against Hong kong, would look to get back to winning ways and get closer to seal their ICC WT20 spot. Their bowling suffered a setback in the previous game and would want to make amends in this one. Oman, on the other hand, were brilliant beating Nigeria and going to the top of the points table. One more win would seal the deal for both the teams and Oman are going into this game as favorites. Toss in a while.
